personality: Glass / Luxe (Dark mode) + iOS-Native Clean (Light mode) Fusion
personality_one_liner: A premium, unified social-audio experience that transitions smoothly from clean and legible daylight feeds to a cinematic, glassy midnight-navy listening lounge.

color_rules: No pure black or un-tinted greys. Always use the specified navy-tinted values.
Primary brand CTA should always use a gradient via `bg-gradient-to-r from-[--brand-grad-start] to-[--brand-grad-end]` when possible.
Use BigPoints gold exclusively for rewards, coins, and premium badges; do not use it for standard warnings.
Filter chips use `--chip-bg` with `--primary` text when active.

headings.styles: Use Outfit for all headers; do not exceed text-6xl. Keep letter-spacing tight.

web.layout: Desktop layout: Left navigation rail (fixed, 240px) + Center main content (flexible, max 800px) + Right discovery/ad rail (fixed, 300px). Video/Radio/Checkout flows span the full width (hide right rail). Padding is generous (p-6 to p-8 internally).
web.surface_microtheme: Crystal Glass in Dark Mode (nav/media dock); Flat/Clean in Light Mode (subtle border and shadow).
web.navigation_header: Global top header with FUUSIC wordmark, market selector, BigPoints badge. Always uses a solid/glassy background (never fully transparent over content) to ensure readability.

components_strategy.marketing_pages: pure HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts to allow overlapping and fluid positioning.
components_strategy.interactive_logic: shadcn primitives heavily customized. Strip raw Vercel looks (remove pure black). Make edges match brand.radius_tokens.
components_strategy.icons: lucide-react with stroke-width 2 to match the clean, readable Outfit font.
components_strategy.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary actions, heavily utilizing the brand gradient.

glassmorphism.enabled: true for sticky headers, nav rails, and the persistent media player.
glassmorphism.recipe: backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-150 bg-white/70 (light) or bg-[#0B0F19]/70 (dark) + 1px inner stroke border-white/10

motion.hover_states: lift (-translate-y-1) and slight shadow increase for cards.
motion.page_transitions: Fade-through (opacity 0 to 1) to match an app-like feel.

web.data_testid: Every interactive element (feed posts, like buttons, media play/pause, navigation tabs) MUST have a kebab-case data-testid.

dos: Sticky global header over scrolling feed

mobile.safe_area: All screen roots must respect SafeAreaView boundaries. The persistent mini media player must float directly above the bottom tab bar.
mobile.touch_targets: All Pressables must be >= 44x44pt. Use hitSlop if the visual icon is smaller. Include testID on all interactive elements.

states.empty: Check back later for more games.

screens.layout: Full-width immersive game banners. Vibrant colors, gold accents, prominent CTA to start playing.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The UI must support seamless toggling between Light, Dark, and System modes. Read the theme preference from /api/shell/prefs.

WEB: Apply the EXACT CSS variables provided in `web.css_variables` to `/app/frontend/src/index.css`. The `--app-bg`, `--surface`, `--brand-grad-start`, `--bigpoints-gold`, etc. variables MUST be implemented exactly as requested.

MOBILE: In `/app/mobile`, you MUST export a JS object in `src/constants/theme.ts` that includes both `light` and `dark` variants mapped to the exact semantic token names (e.g., appBg, surface, surface2, textPrimary, brandGradStart, bigpointsGold). Implement a ThemeProvider that dynamically swaps them.

Both surfaces share the EXACT same visual semantics. Light mode is heavily anchored in #FFFFFF and #F4F4F5 with deep purple accents. Dark mode is anchored in midnight navy (#0B0F19) with vibrant, glowing glassy cards.

The 'Persistent mini media player dock' is a crucial architectural element. It sits permanently above the bottom tab navigation on mobile, and fixed at the bottom of the left/center layout on desktop web. Ensure layout padding avoids overlapping this player.
Avatars and UI components should heavily rely on `Plus Jakarta Sans` for clean data readability, while headers, titles, and numbers use `Outfit` for a friendly, modern music-brand feel.
On Mobile, strictly adhere to the 44x44pt touch target rule for all icon buttons (like, share, play, pause, filter chips) via hitSlop or padding.
